headline: Credo presents mixed-signal PLL verification and CTLE BER analysis for a TSMC 2 nm design
fact: SNUG Taiwan 2026 proceedings list a Credo presentation by Yenlin Lee and Sung En Wang titled “Time-effective Mixed-Signal PLL Verifications with RTVS Cosim and CTLE BER Analysis with Matlab for TSMC 2nm Design.” Synopsys names it a Best Presentation Award winner. The public record establishes the stated mixed-signal PLL/co-simulation and MATLAB CTLE BER-analysis scope for a TSMC 2 nm design; it does not expose the gated presentation’s measured runtime, correlation, or sign-off results.

sources.title: SNUG Taiwan 2026 proceedings
sources.summary: Synopsys lists the Credo presentation by Yenlin Lee and Sung En Wang under Analog Mixed Signal Design and identifies it as a Best Presentation Award winner.

sources.title: SNUG Taiwan 2026 Call for Content portal
sources.summary: The official SNUG Taiwan portal states that the conference was held at the Sheraton Hsinchu Hotel on August 10, 2026.
